text: Do not spend more than Rs 500 on any single transaction, and no more than Rs 15,000 in total across a month.
Cap every single payment at Rs 1,000, and don't let the day's total go past Rs 5,000.
Only allow purchases in the software and subscriptions categories. No spending limit otherwise.
Never allow any purchase in the gambling or crypto categories.
No more than 5 transactions per day.
Anything above Rs 10,000 needs my manual approval before it goes through.
Kisi bhi ek transaction mein 2000 rupaye se zyada kharch mat karo, aur poore mahine mein total 20000 se zyada nahi hona chahiye.
Sirf food aur groceries category mein paise kharch karna allowed hai, baaki kisi category ke liye nahi.
Keep the spending reasonable and don't go overboard.
